items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Well now, when you quit Jack Carey, who came in on trombone with your band?

ctx.x: I don't know myself, but I guess they just figured if we, I don't know, there wasn't nothing wrong with him. I don't know. I didn't see nothing wrong.
Well now, when you quit Jack Carey, who came in on trombone with your band?
E.D. Morris. Right on. I'm right in. I see. I said, George Boyd went and got him right away.
